summary: Biohaven Ltd. disclosed via Form 8-K that its subsidiary entered into a licensing agreement with SK Biopharmaceuticals, granting exclusive worldwide rights to its Kv7 platform including opakalim. Terms include a $400M upfront (deferred), up to $150M milestones, and tiered royalties. This is a strategic out-licensing deal, not a typical special-situation corporate event, so it does not map cleanly to the specified categories.
